title: HyperDrive USB-C & Thunderbolt 4 Dual Monitor Dock, New

comparisons.notes: Same HyperDrive USB-C & Thunderbolt 4 dual monitor dock (4K60Hz HDMI), new, in stock

writeup: Woot has the HyperDrive USB-C & Thunderbolt 4 Dual Monitor Dock new for $29.99. It drives two external displays at 4K60 over HDMI from a single USB-C or Thunderbolt 4 cable. The lowest in-stock price we found elsewhere was $64.13 at Electronics Flip, so this is about 53% less. Only a few were left at posting, limit 3 per customer.
